verses.1: They should search throughout the streets of Jerusalem. See and learn from their surroundings. If anyone is found who seeks justice and honesty, then forgive him.
verses.2: And if Jehovah says lies to you, then they will be believed.
verses.3: YHWH, your eyes have seen the truth. You have brought them back from their suffering. They no longer suffer from our hands. Now take away this burden from them; strengthen their faces from our hands. May they return again.
verses.4: And I said, “They are poor, for they do not know the way of Jehovah in His judgment.”
verses.5: I went to the elders and spoke with them. They knew the ways of Jehovah in judging His gods. But they all together broke the laws and became disobedient.
verses.6: Therefore, lions from the forest, wolves, and other wild beasts will destroy them. All those who come out of there will be destroyed. Their sins are so numerous that they cannot be counted.
verses.7: Oh, how I forgive you, my children! You have left me, and you have gone without God. But I will avenge you. They will be punished, and their houses will be destroyed.
verses.8: Sons who are born from incestuous relations will be like a man who marries his wife’s sister.
verses.9: May the Lord not have mercy on them. And if it is in a country like that, then my soul will not be saved.
verses.10: They climbed onto their backs, and they ate and drank. But do not do those things! Remove all their decorations from them, for it is not pleasing to God.
verses.11: For in the days of their ignorance, they lied against me, in the house of Israel and in the house of Judah. May Jehovah curse them!
verses.12: They tried to see God, but they said, “He will not come to us. There will be no harm, destruction, or famine for us.”
verses.13: And the prophets will become like spirits; there will be no sound or speech from them.
verses.14: Therefore, as Jehovah, the God of hosts says, “Since you have spoken this word, I will give my words to you in your mouth. This people are like trees; they will eat what is given to them.”
verses.15: I will bring to you a nation from far away, from the land of Israel. Let God speak through this nation. It’s a nation from the heavens. It’s a nation that you won’t be able to know about, and you won’t be able to hear what they say.
verses.16: His punishment was like a closed door; all the rulers were destroyed.
verses.17: And your grain and your wheat will be eaten by your children and your daughters. Your fruits and your vines will be eaten by your sheep and goats. The cities of your captivity will be destroyed, because you trust in them.
verses.18: And even in those days, Jehovah said, “I will not do any of these things to you.”
verses.19: And it shall be that when you say, “Under what authority did Jehovah our God do all these things for us?” Then you will say to them, “When you abandoned me and served other gods in your land. So also will you serve those aliens in your land, but not for yourselves.”
verses.20: Speak this in the house of Jacob, and let them hear it in Judah.
verses.21: Listen to this, you foolish people! They have no hearts or eyes to see, and they have no ears to hear.
verses.22: May you not be afraid, O LORD! For from before me, I have set up a boundary along the sea, a limit for eternity. No one can cross that boundary. It will be impossible for anyone to do so. Their waves will not be able to pass through it either.
verses.23: And this people had a cruel heart; they were full of hatred and cruelty. So they went away.
verses.24: And they did not say in their hearts, “Look upon the LORD our God, who gives us rain in its time and makes the crops grow during the season when they should be harvested.”
verses.25: Your sins and transgressions have prevented you from being guided by the good.
verses.26: For there were wicked people in my people, who were like vipers. They set up evil men as leaders.
verses.27: Just as a rabbit is full of holes, so too are their children full of deceit. Therefore, they grow up and become dishonest people.
verses.28: We have done what they did. They also spread evil words among us. They did not do anything good. They will fail, and they will not be able to make judgments. They did not judge their ancestors properly.
verses.29: May the Lord not abandon these people. In a country like that, my soul will not be saved.
verses.30: Shama and Sh’arura became inhabitants of the land.
verses.31: The prophets were brought in deceitfully, and the priests came down upon their own feet. My people also did the same. What will they do next?
